sloka: ते तम् हय हरम् ज्ञात्वा क्रोध पर्याकुल ईक्षणाः ।खनित्र लांगला धर नाना वृक्ष शिला धराः ॥१-४०-२७॥
transliteration: te tam haya haram jñātvā krodha paryākula īkṣaṇāḥ ।khanitra lāṁgalā dhara nānā vṛkṣa śilā dharāḥ ॥1-40-27॥

translations.english: They recognised that best of horses. Their eyes were red with anger. Armed with spades, ploughshares and every kind of tree and stone and furious with wrath, they rushed towards Kapila shouting, wait, wait
